messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - Increased latency and 5xxs observed for embeddings endpoints in us-west-2. Triggering oncall.

elena_m (SRE): getting paged — seeing model load timeouts to the embedding workers, SLO breaches for 60s.

mahesh_p (Eng Runtime): logs show repeated EBS IO timeouts during snapshot mount; container retries spike. attaching extract: `grep -i 'i/o timeout' /var/log/syslog | tail -n 200`

elena_m (SRE): concur. KV-cache warmups failing; fallback to smaller model shards not happening due to mount failures.

ravi_k (Partner Liaison): looping in AWS — @aws-ops can you confirm any ongoing EBS/EC2 issues in us-west-2? Also, we may need a DRT.

aws-ops: Hi team, we're seeing increased API reports for EBS degraded performance in us-west-2. We've opened a DRT with priority P2 so far. Can you provide: affected instances, volume IDs, and a recent job id to correlate?

elena_m (SRE): providing sample list in thread. Instances: i-0a12b34c, i-0d56e78f. Volumes: vol-0abc1234, vol-0def5678. Recent job id: run-2026-03-15T10:04Z-emb-7.

mahesh_p (Eng Runtime): adding: stack traces and container restart counts pasted. Repro: mount fails => runtime falls back to cold-load, which times out at 15s.

ravi_k (Partner Liaison): AWS asked for a timeline and current mitigation steps. Suggest we escalate to AWS DRT P1 — customer impact: some hosted API customers experiencing 30-120s requests or 5xxs for embeddings.

sre-lead: agreed — escalate. ravi_k, please request DRT P1 and ask for a timeline for EBS IO stabilization and remediation ETA. Also request a ticket number and point-of-contact.

ravi_k (Partner Liaison): message sent to AWS support. Excerpt: "We are experiencing production-impacting EBS IO degradation causing model load timeouts for our hosted embedding service (ticket request: P1 escalation). Affected resource list: vol-0abc1234, vol-0def5678; instances i-0a12b34c, i-0d56e78f. Customer impact: elevated latency and 5xx for embeddings; multiple customers impacted. Please assign DRT and provide contact + ETA."

aws-ops: DRT accepted, ticket #DRT-20260315-789. POC: Aria (aria@aws). They plan an initial update in 15 minutes, remediation ETA TBD after analysis.

sam_g (Support): prepping customer-facing note. Draft for status page / support portal: 

```
We are currently investigating increased latency and errors for the embeddings API in the US-West region. Our engineers have identified degraded block-storage performance with the cloud provider impacting model load times. We are working with the provider to remediate and will post updates here. If you are experiencing production impact, please reply to this thread with your org id and incident id.
```

elena_m (SRE): small internal update for ops channel: mitigation working path: 1) spin up ephemeral instances using local NVMe-backed images to serve hot-models (fast dir fallback) 2) route new requests to dedicated warm pool 3) failover non-critical tenants to reduced throughput mode.

mahesh_p (Eng Runtime): I'm preparing a hotfix to change mount retry/backoff and enable async KV-cache population to avoid blocking request paths. Patching can be staged to dedicated pool within 10-12 min.

ravi_k (Partner Liaison): AWS DRT asked whether we can shift traffic away from affected volumes; they recommended snapshot + detach pattern but warned about read-after-write consistency. We'll coordinate safer temporary launch from clean NVMe images.

status-bot: [STATUS PAGE] Draft update queued: "Investigating: latency and errors affecting Embeddings API in us-west-2. We are working with the cloud provider; status and ETA to follow." (needs approval)

sam_g (Support): Approved. I'll publish to status page and send customer broadcast to active trial and paid customers with affected endpoints. Template below — please edit if needed: 

```
Subject: Service interruption affecting embeddings in US-West-2
Body: We're investigating increased latency and failed requests for our embeddings endpoints in the US-West-2 region. Our engineers are working with the cloud provider (ticket DRT-20260315-789) to restore normal service. We will provide updates every 30 minutes. If you are experiencing production issues, please respond to this email with your org id and request id.

Impact: Partial outage for embeddings in us-west-2.
Workaround: Use embeddings endpoints in us-east-1 or eu-west-1 where available, or retry with exponential backoff.

Estimated next update: +30min
```

elena_m (SRE): small note — include specific API paths to help customers triage: `/v1/embeddings` and `/v1/embeddings-batch`. Also add guidance for SDK clients to enable retries with jitter.

ravi_k (Partner Liaison): AWS update: initial analysis points to a noisy neighbor on the underlying EBS cluster causing elevated IO latency; they're isolating affected hosts. AWS asked if we can coordinate a rolling replacement of affected volumes to minimize impact.

mahesh_p (Eng Runtime): rolling replace via snapshot+relaunch is risky for live workloads. Prefer to bring warm-pool up on NVMe-backed ephemeral images and slowly shift traffic. I'll trigger the pool and start traffic draining from affected instances.

elena_m (SRE): executing runbook: `./ops/drain-instance.sh i-0a12b34c && ./ops/launch-warm-pool --type nvme-small --region us-west-2 --count 4` — posting logs in 2min.

oncall-bot: Draining in progress. Metric: embeddings_success_rate now 87% (was 68%). Error rate trending down.

aws-ops: AWS DRT status: currently isolating host cluster; continuing analysis. Next update in 10 minutes. POC Aria available on DRT channel.

sam_g (Support): customers notified. Got initial replies from two large tenants who asked for ETA; forwarded DRT ticket and our mitigation plan.

sre-lead: good. Please keep status page cadence. Also prepare an internal incident summary template for execs. Suggested short form: 

```
Incident summary (1-line): Embeddings API impaired in us-west-2 due to cloud provider EBS IO degradation.
Impact: Partial outage, elevated latency and 5xx for embeddings; some customers affected.
Action taken: Eng spun NVMe warm pool, draining affected instances, working with AWS DRT (DRT-20260315-789).
Next steps: Continue mitigation; consider cross-region failover for critical tenants; post updates every 30m.
Owner: elena_m / mahesh_p / ravi_k

```

elena_m (SRE): handing off to night oncall @mahesh_p — I'll summarize in 5m.

mahesh_p (Eng Runtime): taking over. Handoff ack. Current state: warm-pool 4x nvme up, draining 2 instances, error rate down to 4xx per minute. AWS DRT open, POC Aria. I'll continue updates and coordinate final rollback once AWS confirms host isolation.

ravi_k (Partner Liaison): will keep AWS engaged and request post-mortem and RCA timeline. Also prepping vendor comms to include in customer follow-up.

sam_g (Support): logging incident with support case links. I'll send follow-up to customers after next status update.

oncall-bot: Hand-off recorded. New oncall: mahesh_p. Incident channel remains locked for updates.

mahesh_p (Eng Runtime): quick note to oncall playbook — if AWS ETA > 2h, escalate to cross-region failover plan for top 10 paying customers. I'll prepare a runbook checklist now.

ravi_k (Partner Liaison): AWS just posted update in DRT: remediation in progress; suggested host replacement timeline 45-90min. They will share final RCA when complete.

status-bot: [STATUS PAGE] Update posted: "Mitigation underway: traffic shifting to warm NVMe pool; AWS investigating EBS cluster issue (DRT-20260315-789). Next update in 30 minutes."

elena_m (SRE): thanks team. leaving notes in incident tracker and putting links to AWS DRT. Any follow-ups, please tag me.

mahesh_p (Eng Runtime): will keep this thread as single source of truth. If anything changes I'll @everyone.

sam_g (Support): noting customers requesting credits/investigation — keep a log of affected org ids.

ravi_k (Partner Liaison): closing loop with AWS for now; will reopen if new info.

oncall-bot: Incident status: mitigation in progress. Participants: elena_m, mahesh_p, ravi_k, aws-ops, sam_g.
